content: Terbinafine (topical) is an antifungal medication approved by the FDA for the treatment of itching, burning, cracking, and scaling associated with athlete's foot (tinea pedis) and jock itch (tinea cruris). It is also effective in treating ringworm (tinea corporis). Common adverse reactions include diarrhea, dyspepsia, rash, pruritus, and urticaria. For adult patients, terbinafine (topical) is FDA-approved to cure most cases of athlete's foot, jock itch, and ringworm. It also alleviates symptoms such as itching, burning, cracking, and scaling associated with these conditions. Off-label uses in adults are not well-documented, and there is limited information regarding guideline-supported or non-guideline-supported off-label use. In pediatric patients, there is limited information available regarding FDA-labeled indications, dosages, or off-label uses of terbinafine (topical). Similarly, there is no specific guidance for its use in pregnancy, labor and delivery, nursing mothers, geriatric populations, or immunocompromised patients. Additionally, there is no FDA guidance on its use in patients with renal or hepatic impairment, or in specific gender or racial populations. Terbinafine (topical) is for external use only. It should not be applied to nails, the scalp, or near the mouth, eyes, or for vaginal yeast infections. If the product comes into contact with the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water. Discontinue use and consult a doctor if excessive irritation occurs, symptoms worsen, or side effects develop. Keep the product out of reach of children, and seek medical help immediately if swallowed. To administer, use the tip of the cap to break the seal and open the tube. Wash the affected skin with soap and water, then dry completely before application. For athlete's foot, wear well-fitting, ventilated shoes and change shoes and socks at least once daily. Apply the medication twice daily (morning and night) for one week for infections between the toes, or for two weeks for infections on the bottom or sides of the foot. For jock itch and ringworm, apply once daily for one week. Wash hands after each use. There is limited information available regarding clinical trial experience, postmarketing experience, drug interactions, pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and nonclinical toxicology of terbinafine (topical). Overdose information is also limited, but in cases of suspected overdose, contact the National Poison Help hotline immediately. Store terbinafine (topical) at controlled room temperature, between 20°C and 25°C (68°F to 77°F). There is no established interaction between terbinafine and alcohol, but patients should consult their doctor regarding alcohol consumption while using this medication. The brand name for terbinafine (topical) is ANTIFUNGAL®.
